name: Verify project context
description: Audit existing context for staleness, contradictions, and completeness. Flag issues for resolution.
whenToUse: Periodic health check of project context, or before major workflow runs to ensure context is current.

team.perspective: Systematically check context files for issues, staleness, and contradictions.
Challenge assumptions, probe for hidden contradictions, test invalidation conditions.
Compile findings into actionable report with prioritized fixes.

texts.audit-checklist:
## Context Audit Checklist

**Staleness checks:**
- [ ] Check `invalidatedBy` conditions against current state
- [ ] Verify timestamps are recent (flag if >30 days old)
- [ ] Check if technology versions have changed
- [ ] Verify file paths referenced still exist

**Contradiction checks:**
- [ ] Cross-reference facts with decisions
- [ ] Check for conflicting statements across files
- [ ] Verify perspectives don't contradict facts
- [ ] Check decision rationales are still valid

**Completeness checks:**
- [ ] All required sections present in files
- [ ] Headers properly formatted
- [ ] Rationale present for all decisions
- [ ] Sources cited for facts

**Severity levels:**
- **Critical**: Contradictions that could cause incorrect agent behavior
- **Warning**: Stale content that may mislead
- **Info**: Minor issues or improvement suggestions

phases.title: Inventory context files
phases.goal: Auditor lists all context files and their metadata (type, source, confidence, updated date).
instructions: Create inventory with: path, type, source, confidence, updated, size
Note files that haven't been updated in >30 days

phases.title: Deep content audit
phases.goal: Challenger probes each file for issues, testing invalidation conditions and looking for contradictions.
instructions: For each decision with `invalidatedBy`, check if conditions are now true
Cross-reference facts across files for contradictions
Verify referenced file paths still exist in project
Check if technology versions in facts match current project
List all findings with severity level

phases.title: Prioritize findings
phases.goal: Debate the severity and priority of each finding. Agree on what needs immediate action vs. future cleanup.
instructions: Agree on priority order for fixes
Identify which issues need user input

phases.title: User review of critical issues
phases.goal: Present critical issues to user for decision on how to resolve contradictions or confirm stale facts.

phases.title: Verification report
phases.goal: Compile findings into a structured report with actionable recommendations.
instructions: List critical issues with recommended fixes
Recommend next audit timeframe based on findings

triggers: Critical contradiction found between facts and decisions
Multiple stale decisions affect active workflows
